dialogues.speaker: Unknown Creation
dialogues.text: An unknown creation, with origins deep in the past. It seems to be able to affect the phlogiston in the environment.

dialogues.speaker: Phlogiston Node
dialogues.text: A creation left behind by the ancient dragons of Natlan. It can change the direction of phlogiston flow, creating a Spiritway. This might be the prototype on which Spiritdoors are based.
